NavigationItem.use: List the destinations in one array, each { label, icon, href or onSelect, count, group, current }, and pass it to NavigationDrawer, Rail or Bar, which render the items; selected is current, a count in end is count. No codemod rewrites it: rewrite each list by hand.

NavigationItemProps.use: Destination, one item of the array that Bar, Rail and NavigationDrawer take, or DrawerDestination, whose icon is optional.
